work: Book mark, seal, signature, brand bible, announcement film

sb-03-book-02-4x5.text: Left, the original ink drawing. Right, the solid version, still legible at the size of a favicon.

sb-04-seal-01-16x9.text: “For readers and writers” didn't need writing. It was already stitched into her label.

sb-05-signature-02-16x9.text: Sloop Script, tidied to be read rather than admired, with a custom S. The flourishes were politely declined.

sb-12-bible-01-16x9.text: A 24-page brand bible, set like a book because it was for a bookshop. Behind it sit 46 pages of studies.
